gui.copper_age_patch.jei.info.copper_gol:
Copper Golem:
Built by placing a Copper Block, placing a Carved Pumpkin on top, and interacting with a Lightning Rod or Copper Button.

Over time, it oxidizes through four stages: Unaffected, Exposed, Weathered, and Oxidized. When fully oxidized, it freezes into a statue!

Use Honeycomb to wax and freeze its oxidation. Use an Axe to scrape off wax or reduce oxidation. Lightning strikes clear all oxidation.

Copper Golems love pressing copper buttons and can transport items between storage containers. An Iron Golem can offer a poppy flower, which the Copper Golem will wear on its antenna.

Copper Golem Statue:
Created when a Copper Golem fully oxidizes, or when picked up.

Right-click or sneak-right-click to cycle through different decorative poses!

Can be waxed with Honeycomb to preserve its appearance, or scraped with an Axe to de-oxidize.
gui.copper_age_patch.jei.info.shelf:
Copper Age Shelf:
Displays and stores up to 4 items visually.

Right-click a slot to place an item, or right-click with an empty hand to retrieve it.

Emits a Redstone Comparator signal proportional to the number of items stored.
gui.copper_age_patch.jei.info.copper_arm:
Copper Armor:
Offers defense balanced between Leather and Iron armor tiers.

Can be trimmed at a Smithing Table with any vanilla armor trim template. Trimming with a Copper Ingot produces a high-contrast dark copper trim.

Repairs on an Anvil using Copper Ingots.
gui.copper_age_patch.jei.info.copper_too:
Copper Tools:
Mining speed and durability balanced between Stone and Iron tiers.

Repairs on an Anvil using Copper Ingots.

When the Tool Trims mod is installed, copper tools can also be trimmed at a Smithing Table with Linear, Tracks, Charge, and Frost patterns across 10 mineral materials.
gui.copper_age_patch.jei.info.copper_che:
Copper Chest:
A storage container that weathers over time just like other copper blocks.

Can be waxed with Honeycomb to freeze its oxidation stage, or scraped with an Axe to remove wax or oxidation.
gui.copper_age_patch.jei.info.copper_rec:
Copper Recycling & Nuggets:
9 Copper Nuggets can be crafted into 1 Copper Ingot, and 1 Copper Ingot can be crafted back into 9 Copper Nuggets.

When the Create mod is installed, copper armor and tools can be recycled in a Crushing Wheel to recover copper ingots and nuggets.
gui.copper_age_patch.jei.info.copper_hor:
Copper Horse Armor:
Provides protection for horses between Leather and Iron horse armor tiers.

Found in dungeon, desert pyramid, jungle temple, and village chests.
